primary_rule.source: Candidate rule for scientific review; final disposition pending
primary_rule.loss: mean absolute scaled error of ensemble mean
primary_rule.comparison: unrounded MASE strictly below every benchmark
primary_rule.lag: one plus maximum later origins inside forecast window, as existing evaluation.dm_horizon
primary_rule.pass: point-better on all primary comparisons and every p_less<0.05
primary_rule.fail: any primary point MASE at or above its benchmark
primary_rule.inconclusive: point-better but insufficient or undefined inference

origins: fit origin plus month starts with complete horizon support
fitting: reconstruct released estimators once at day before exclusive fit cut; keep blocks/tables/draws immutable
state_clock: 23:59:59 UTC at each origin; accepted_at must be no later than that instant
daily_window: before exclusive score_until; exclude all Granite start day from fitting and Helicon partial day from daily score
event_window: Granite16:00UTC to Helicon15:00UTC for protected labels; exact maturity by target
missingness: fail on missing/incomplete/duplicate daily stocks; no silent date or comparator substitution
behaviour_table: frozen point renewal/return blocks and conditional duration tables; prior/history/persistence frozen before fit cut; separate from system ensemble verdict
unresolved: Final primary-series/origin/decision-rule adoption before a witnessed scientific freeze
Foundation answer or explicit G8 team-default definition and remaining contractual acceptance gap
Total-bonded and staking-ratio scope: released validator model supplies no delegation forecast
Final source/window fitness, scientific registration review, witness and independent runner

behaviour_targets.renewal_7d: Ended validator commitments with full7-day follow-up strictly before event end; same-node successor in[end,end+7days].
behaviour_targets.return_8_90d_given_no_7d_renewal: Full90-day follow-up, conditional on no observed7-day renewal; daily frozen hazard survival over days8through90.
behaviour_targets.next_duration_days: First nonoverlapping successor started before event end; exact scheduled duration rounded to nearest whole day, minimum1.
behaviour_targets.leave_365d: Deferred because this evaluation window does not mature365-day labels.
behaviour_targets.baselines: Prior, node history and node persistence from source eligible by the frozen fit cut. Renewal/return baseline cohorts use365pre-fit days.
behaviour_targets.distribution: Frozen point coefficients and empirical duration tables, separate from200-draw system scores.

pre_outcome_overlap_check.algorithm: one plus maximum later origins strictly inside forecast window
